chapter_title: Concerning the Three Images that are in the righteous Person.
chapter_note: After a brief hagiographic opening, the chapter is largely a systematic, process-oriented exposition of a threefold inner structure (spiritual/psychic/corporeal) and the ascent/purification of the living soul through these degrees, culminating in the action of the Light Virgin/Virgin of Light. Only the final paragraph shows probable Christian-moral coloring (virtues; ‘first/last’ formula), while the main mechanism remains cosmological-anthropological rather than institutional/pastoral.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic hagiographic dialogue-introduction (“Once again… speaks to his disciples”), a classic Kephalaia frame marker.

paragraphs.core_text: Three images occur in the elect person.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Programmatic thesis statement introducing a numbered, systematic anthropological structure; no citation, exhortation, or institutional rule.

paragraphs.core_text: The first is the spiritual image, which is the new man, which the Light Mind shall form in him; and it goes into him and dwells in him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Degree-language (“first…”) and impersonal mechanism (Light Mind forms/dwells) typical of the systematic teaching layer.

paragraphs.core_text: The second image is the remnant and remainder of the new man, which is the psychic image that is bound in the flesh, as the old man [ ... since the] times of this psychic image.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the numbered degree-structure (“second…”) and defines entities by function/state (bound in flesh), not by contemporary application.

paragraphs.core_text: The other one is the corporeal image [that is] added to them all.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the triad in a compact, schematic manner; still purely structural.

paragraphs.core_text: These three images [ ... ] entirely. When it will [ ... ... ] through the nourishment of food. If it shall sink [ ... ... ] down to the corporeal image. [And] the corporeal, [that] is in it, shall divest itself of it and place it in the [ ... ] image. [ ... ] again it rises up and falls to the [ ... ] image; it shall divest itself of the psychical of the enemies, which [ ... ... ] anger. The lust [ ... ... ... ] with it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Process-description of ascent/stripping through degrees (divesting/placing/rising) is characteristic of core mechanism-teaching; ‘food’ functions here as part of the cosmological economy of mixture/purification rather than a pastoral command.

paragraphs.core_text: Then shall a Light Virgin come and reveal the spiritual image that is [there], which [is] the new man. That Virgin acts as a guide. [She g]oes on before and it is extended to the heights above, and received into this spiritual image. And she [sculpts] it and adorns it with the new man [wi]thin. It is sealed with all the limbs of this Light Virgin who is present and dwells in the new man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mythic agent (Light Virgin) operating within a defined soteriological mechanism (reveal/guide/seal) in impersonal expository voice; cosmos→cosmos operation.

paragraphs.core_text: So, this is [h]ow this living limb shall be [puri]fied and live, the one that comes into the body of [the ri]ghteous one from without through the administration of food of various ki[nds], like this. The living soul shall be clea[n]sed entirely every [d]ay and traverse these three [im]a[ges].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative ‘how it works’ explanation of purification-as-process; despite “administration of food,” the paragraph remains descriptive and mechanistic, not disciplinary.

paragraphs.core_text: So, it shall divest itself of the body, which is not its own, in the corporeal. It shall also divest itself of the souls that are not its own, these that are mixed with it in the psychical [ ... ... ] anger and desire and [ ... ]-ness and foolishness and envy and strife; and these other wicked teachings that are not its own.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the stripping/mixture logic (foreign accretions removed by degree), still internal to the anthropology of mixture rather than an address to contemporary institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: However, in [the] spiritual image itself it shall live. It is the Virgin of Light who robes the new man and who shall be cal[l]ed ‘the hour of life’.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed moral/Christianized virtue cluster and possible NT-style formula: “be joined with long-sufferingness, the perfection of faith and love that reigns over them all” and “She is the f[irst], but s[h]e is also the last,” as likely later devotional overlay inserted into an otherwise cosmological description of the Virgin of Light’s action.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core mechanism (life in the spiritual image; Virgin of Light robes the new man; ‘hour of life’ epithet) is systematic and mythic. The inserted virtues (faith/love/long-suffering) and ‘first/last’ formula sound like later Christian-moral diction rather than the impersonal degree-mechanics of the substrate.
